method: Actual shipped 60 FPS rules executed in Node; real attack, trap, guard, observation and CPU processing. Initial balance, not a competitive certification.

results.name: The 354 historical fighters and stories do not acquire an original UID
Every original command has authored timing, cost and explicit counterplay
Original definition cloning cannot mutate the stored definition
A real contact finishes an original duel and records a round win
Real CPU sparring uses authored attacks, movement and positive damage
Low-autonomy CPU does not spend its remaining battery on a non-recharging optic
Leurre startup cannot place or damage before frame 30
A committed visible hit interrupts the trap preparation
An unarmed local trap cannot trigger even inside its visible radius
An armed local trap triggers once and creates a short slowing status
A nearby opponent can destroy the visible trap before it arms
Low guard blocks trap damage and prevents its slow status
Standing guard fails against a low snare
Recall removes only the owner local trap without damage or resource refund
Recall cannot erase a trap beyond 240 pixels
A second original trap replaces the first; there is never more than one
The super requires tactical meter and replaces the local trap
Low autonomy denies the optic rather than activating for free
Optic observes a past trace before the opponent current-frame movement
Optic cannot mark beyond 380 pixels
A masked silhouette suppresses observation without revealing future inputs
Damage during optic preparation prevents activation and marking
Observed melee bonus lasts for one confirmed strike only
A conventional high projectile can be ducked and respects resource cost
A grounded low sweep uses the authored crouched hurtbox rather than an invisible standing head
Backstep remains a vulnerable finite displacement
Training prevents KO while preserving real collisions and damage counters
Original CPU runs are deterministic under the same seed
